# About this repository

Sample documents for Lunascape Docs (LSD-ADR-0021: one repository, one documentation set per folder). `spec/` is a functional specification, `paper/` a short paper. Each set has its own `lunascape-docs.json`, languages and INDEX; translations sit in `i18n/<locale>/` beside the canonical files. The root `README.md` is the home page and stays short.

Read them at <https://docs.lunascape.org/?source=github:gu-corp/lunascape-docs-sample@main>. Pull requests are welcome.
